title: $L^2$-Cohomology of Strongly Centered Monopole Moduli Spaces
exact_target: Determine the square-integrable cohomology dimensions of strongly centered SU(2) monopole moduli spaces.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002073 (OWR-11787-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

status_qualification: The report frames this as Sen's conjecture and seeks metric control at infinity. The freshly consulted Fritzsch--Kottke--Singer Part I abstract describes a partial result and explicitly says that a key compactification theorem is deferred to Part II; it is not taken as proof of the whole charge-general conjecture. The brief report does not state every character-sector formula, so none is invented.
